IS 11282 : 2000 Guidelines for Laboratory Pot-grate Sintering Tests for Iron Ore FinesICS 73.060.10;01.110MTD 13Reaffirmed 20141 ScopeThis standard gives the guidelines for the method for sinteringtests in the laboratory using a pot-grate unit and is applicablefor sintering of iron ore fines. These guidelines have beenformulated to facilitate comparison of test data from variousorganizations on the same sinter mix. For individual organizations,the parameter may be varied, as required.2 ReferencesIS 6495 : 1984Method of tumbler test for iron oxides: lump ores,sinter and pelletsIS 8167 : 1989Method for determination of reducibility index of ironore oxides, lumps ore, sinter and pelletsIS 10823 : 1994Methods for determination of thermal degradation index(TDI) and reduction degradation index (RDI) of ironoxides: lump ore, sinter and pelletsIS 11283 : 1985Determination of softening point of iron oxides (inpowder form): lump ore, sinter and pelletsIS 11292 : 1985Determination of relative reducibility of iron oxides:lump ore, sinter and pelletsIS 12550 : 1988Methods of determining particle size distribution of ironore fines
